text.en:
For the purpose of settling the long standing territorial dispute between the Mountain Province
and the Province of Cagayan and in pursuance of section sixty-eight of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred
and eleven, known as the Administrative Code, as amended by Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and
twenty-nine, the Governor-General is hereby authorized to fix and define the boundary between said
provinces in accordance with the mutual agreement between the respective provincial boards of said
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1929.
